significance.value: 4.2σ (stat.+sys.) evidence for polarization lensing and lensing B modes

summary.plain: POLARBEAR reported the first direct evidence, from the Big Bang afterglow alone, that matter along the line of sight bends its polarization, creating B-mode patterns, at 4.2 standard deviations.
summary.technical: POLARBEAR first-season 30 deg^2: four-point correlations of E and B modes give polarization lensing and lensing B modes at 4.2 sigma (stat.+sys.); matter-fluctuation amplitude measured to 27%, consistent with LCDM.

title: Measurement of the Cosmic Microwave Background Polarization Lensing Power Spectrum with the POLARBEAR experiment
why_it_matters: The abstract says "We report the first direct evidence for polarization lensing based on purely CMB information".
